messages:
morgan: 🚨 Heads up — I'm pausing the rest of today's releases. We just saw a KV cache regression on eu-prod-canary causing a spike in 5xx and cache invalidations. Pinning runtime-image and holding; need ops + release ops input.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot has paused deployments: all pipelines targeting change window 15:00-18:00 are blocked by @morgan.

ava: Confirmed the spike at 14:12 UTC on eu-prod-canary. KV miss storm looks correlated with the kernel flag tweak from earlier canary. Reverting that flag in a test fixed latency in staging.

sam: Proposed immediate rollback of runtime-image to v2.8.1 for canary, run smoke, then staggered resume if stable. Also recommend pinning model+runtime for 24h.

priya: Noted — 2 enterprise customers hit timeouts; CS is informed and I'm opening a CR to track customer impact.

morgan: Plan of record: 1) rollback canary -> runtime-image:v2.8.1 2) 5m smoke + 15m load watch 3) if stable, resume with staged rollout 10% -> 50% over 2h and monitor KV-miss/5xx. Pin current model/runtime versions for 24h. Eng-oncall, please standby.

deploy-bot: To execute rollback: `/deploy rollback --service runtime --image runtime-image:v2.8.1 --env eu-prod-canary`

ava: Running rollback now and tailing logs, will post results in thread.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Rollback initiated by ava at 14:25 UTC. Estimated completion 3m.

ava: Rollback finished 14:28 UTC. Early signals look better — 5xxs dropping toward baseline. Starting smoke tests (3-runs).

sam: Smoke run 1/3 passed. Kicking off small load test next.

morgan: If load holds for 15m and no KV miss spike, we'll resume with the staggered plan. Also adding temporary routing fallback: prefer model-variant-fallback when latency > 300ms.

priya: I'll post a short update to customers and CSMs: "Deployments paused; canary rollback in progress; monitoring." Updating status page now.

devex: We should add an alert rule for KV-miss-rate > 0.5% (prod) to trigger an automated fallback and page eng-oncall. Filing infra issue: https://git.company/infra/issue/3456

sam: Also recommend a 24h freeze on kernel flag merges to runtime until we validate telemetry. CC: @eng-releases.

morgan: Freeze = agreed. I'll write internal release note: pinned runtime-image:v2.8.1, canary rollback, deployments on hold for 24h, retry schedule TBD. Will update thread when we have a concrete resume window.

deploy-bot: All change-window jobs are blocked. To unblock run `/deploy resume-window --id 2025-03-15-15` (requires lead approval).

morgan: Thanks everyone — keep posting any anomalies in this thread. I'll create follow-up with exact restart plan if metrics stay green. :thumbsup:
